newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Credit neutral extensions.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Credit neutral extensions.

text.p: Bond analysts' latest Eurobond trade ideas featured Eurodollars and sterling.
**Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters**
STRATEGY This credit neutral trade can be done for no
yield loss, effectively picking up the curve from 01/01 to 02/02, currently worth 13 basis points.
STRATEGY This Eurodollar switch offers a pick up of 42
b.p. beating the curve by 30 b.p. The spread is at a two-month high, the average spread being 32 b.p. and the low 24 b.p.
STRATEGY This switch offers an improved credit rating to
AA from A while maintaining yield.
STRATEGY The spread on the EIB is around two b.p. over
whereas for the same maturity the KfW is trading around 12 b.p. over and NTT is around +17 b.p.
